toegepas.blok: Nie net in die klaskamer nie
toegepas.voor: Iemand anders is rustig met diere
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'is rustig met diere' follows English 'is calm with animals'; 'hanteer diere rustig' is the natural Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'is rustig met diere' copies English 'is calm with animals'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'hanteer diere rustig' is the natural Afrikaans for the same strength and fits the dog-training example that follows.

toegepas.voor: goed met somme en jy teken mooi
toegepas.na: goed met somme, en jy teken mooi
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subject and verb, so a comma is needed.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('Die kind ... is' and 'jy teken').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.

toegepas.voor: om dinge te verduidelik en sy praat
toegepas.na: om dinge te verduidelik, en sy praat
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full sentences ('Ayanda hou ...' and 'sy praat ...'), so a comma is needed.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('Ayanda hou' and 'sy praat').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans uses 'op' for an event day ('op sportdag', 'op voorleesdag'), not 'by'.
toegepas.fout: 'By' is the looser preposition for an event day.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Op die skool se voorleesdag' is the idiomatic form for a day, and the time and place stay the same.

toegepas.rede_vinder: She read the story aloud to the class on a reading-aloud day, which is 'voorgelees', not just 'gelees'.
toegepas.fout: 'gelees' is imprecise for reading aloud to a listening class.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'voorgelees' is the exact verb for what the paragraph already shows (she stood up and the class listened), and it adds no new fact.

toegepas.voor: Die klas het stil geluister en die juffrou
toegepas.na: Die klas het stil geluister, en die juffrou
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: two sentences with their own subject and verb joined by 'en' take a comma.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('Die klas het' and 'die juffrou het').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.

toegepas.voor: met sy hande en hy maak dinge reg
toegepas.na: met sy hande, en hy maak dinge reg
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full sentences ('werk Sipho ...' and 'hy maak ...'), so a comma is needed.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('werk Sipho' and 'hy maak').
toegepas.rede_keurder: This is only a comma, so the home example stays an exciting experience and does not become an achievement.

toegepas.na: hoe 'n ou enjin van binne lyk
toegepas.rede_vinder: The fixed expression is 'van binne lyk'; 'binne lyk' alone is incomplete.
toegepas.fout: 'binne lyk' is an incomplete form of the fixed expression 'van binne lyk'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: This fixes the expression and does not change what Sipho did, so the home example stays an experience, not an achievement.

toegepas.voor: Neo hardloop vinnig en hy wen
toegepas.na: Neo hardloop vinnig, en hy wen
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma is needed.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses ('Neo hardloop' and 'hy wen').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans says 'op sportdag', not 'by die sportdag'.
toegepas.fout: 'By' is the looser preposition for an event day.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Op die sportdag' is the idiomatic form, matches change 6, and leaves the time and event the same.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'laaste geëindig' copies English 'finished last'; in a race Afrikaans says 'laaste gekom'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'laaste gekom' is the natural Afrikaans for a race result, with the same meaning.

toegepas.na: Sy teken egter goed, en sy kyk

toegepas.rede_keurder: Each clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.

laat_vaar.voor: sterkpunt raak te sien. Jy doen dit goed
laat_vaar.na: sterkpunt raak te sien: jy doen dit goed
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The next sentence is the list of the three things just announced, so a colon joins them more clearly than a full stop.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The two short sentences already read clearly after 'Drie dinge'; the colon only merges them into one 22-word sentence, longer than any other in this Grade 4 lesson.

laat_vaar.blok: Gebruik jou sterkpunt om beter te word
laat_vaar.voor: Sy kleur die letters in wat sy dikwels verkeerd kry.
laat_vaar.na: Die letters wat sy dikwels verkeerd kry, kleur sy in.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The particle 'in' splits 'die letters' from its relative clause; fronting the object keeps them together and ends on the separable verb.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Putting the relative clause after the particle 'in' is normal Afrikaans, and fronting the object makes the sentence harder for a Grade 4 reader.

na_skrywer.blok: Nie net in die klaskamer nie
na_skrywer.voor: en nie almal lê in die klaskamer nie
na_skrywer.na: en hulle lê nie almal in die klaskamer nie
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A bare 'almal' reads as 'all people'; 'hulle ... nie almal' makes clear it refers to the strengths.
na_skrywer.fout: A bare 'almal' first reads as 'all people' rather than the strengths, because 'sterkpunt' is singular.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but the proposed 'hulle' can point to 'mense' just as easily, so the writer needs a different fix that names the strengths.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: weer op die baan gedraf en net so vinnig gehardloop
na_skrywer.na: weer op die baan gehardloop, net so vinnig soos altyd
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'gedraf' (jogged) clashes with 'vinnig gehardloop' in the same sentence, and 'net so vinnig' lacks the comparison it needs.
na_skrywer.fout: 'gedraf' (jogged) sits awkwardly beside 'net so vinnig gehardloop' in the same sentence.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The clash is real, but the proposal drops what Neo did and adds 'soos altyd', a new claim, so the writer should fix it instead.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.rede: 'vra jou daarvoor' (ask you for it) is vague and slightly unidiomatic; it could mean that friends ask for your help with it or ask you to do it, and choosing would mean guessing the intended content.
